yuletide: Somewhere, in the frowsy dark, she had seized a toy, a symbol of Miss Esteena's charity at Yuletide, and shaking it gave it to him.
The people she lived with were rheumatic and not much given to yuletide festivities.
yule: But since his disappearance at Yule-tide, nothing had been seen or heard of him in Lud-in-the-Mist, and Mumchance could find no traces of him.
He left his place--and his wages not paid, too, during the twelve nights of Yule-tide.
yulka: Anna and Yulka showed me three small barrels; one full of dill pickles, one full of chopped pickles, and one full of pickled watermelon rinds.
My first trip was to the post-office, and the next day I went over to take Yulka and Ántonia for a sleigh-ride.
Anna and Yulka left their chairs from time to time to bring fresh plates of kolaches and pitchers of milk.
Yulka curled up like a baby rabbit and played with a grasshopper. Ántonia pointed up to the sky and questioned me with her glance.
Couldn’t we settle down and live in Russian Peter’s house, Yulka asked, and couldn’t I go to town and buy things for us to keep house with?
When I rode up to the Shimerdas’ one bright windy afternoon in April, Yulka ran out to meet me.
yulka's: I took off my long woollen comforter and wound it around Yulka’s throat.
